cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the seed packets. The allotment letter says we're on the waiting list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered our number. If it's another year indoors, I'm giving up gardening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The important bit is we're on it. Let's start tomatoes on my windowsill.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll get tired of them before we get a plot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my sunny room. I'll move the bed; keep the packets.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 commands keeping seeds; A3 evades the covered position and proposes windowsill planting; A5 yields a whole room to keep B gardening despite doubtful hope.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 covered number and threatened quitting explain A refusal to reveal it; A5 moving the bed directly expands the limited windowsill offer.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to know the actual wait and B4 doubts A will tolerate a long occupation of the space.

heightening.evidence: B4 predicted impatience causes A5 a larger concrete commitment that still withholds the number.

specificity.evidence: A1 allotment list and B2 another year indoors make the hidden information and immediate stakes clear.
